features.description: Journey Job Manager — Quản trị jobs với queue, retry, và status tracking
acceptance_criteria: Mỗi workflow execution tạo một Job với unique ID
Job có lifecycle: queued → running → completed/failed
Retry logic: auto-retry failed nodes (configurable max retries)
Job queue: xử lý tuần tự hoặc concurrent (configurable)
Cancel job đang chạy
Job history: list tất cả jobs với filter by status
Real-time progress updates qua WebSocket hoặc polling
test_steps: Execute workflow → verify Job created với status 'queued'
Verify Job transitions: queued → running → completed
Force fail một node → verify auto-retry
Exceed max retries → verify Job status 'failed'
Submit 3 jobs → verify queue processing order
Cancel running job → verify status 'cancelled'
GET /api/v1/jobs → verify history with filters
Verify real-time progress updates on frontend

evidence.test_run: 29 tests pass in tests/test_job_queue.py covering lifecycle, cancellation, timeout, concurrency, retry, listing, cleanup
evidence.e2e: Backend: job_queue.py (async queue + workers + timeout), job_executor.py (per-node retry), job_events.py (SSE pub/sub), journey_jobs.py (REST API). Frontend: useJobManager.ts (composable), JobPanel.vue (UI), JourneyWorkflow.vue (integrated)

features.notes: Production-grade job system: async queue with configurable concurrency (2 workers), per-node retry with exponential backoff, job timeout (default 300s), SSE real-time progress, PostgreSQL persistence, auto-cleanup. Frontend integrated with JobPanel bottom panel and Jobs toolbar button.

features.description: Journey Stateful Execution — Persistent state giữa các nodes và sessions
acceptance_criteria: Mỗi workflow execution có persistent state (không mất khi refresh)
State lưu output của từng node → node sau đọc được
Resume execution: nếu fail ở node 3, có thể resume từ node 3
Checkpoint: save intermediate state vào DB
State viewer: UI hiển thị state hiện tại của workflow
Context passing: nodes chia sẻ context (metadata, extracted data)
test_steps: Execute workflow 5 nodes → verify state saved sau mỗi node
Refresh page giữa execution → verify state persisted
Force fail node 3 → fix → click Resume → verify tiếp từ node 3
Open State Viewer → verify thấy output từng node
Node B đọc output của Node A → verify context passing works
Verify state cleanup sau khi job completed (configurable retention)

evidence.test_run: 20 tests pass in tests/test_execution_state.py covering state creation, node output save/get, context passing, lifecycle transitions, resume point tracking, graceful degradation without repo
evidence.e2e: Backend: execution_state.py (service), workflow_repository.py (execution_states table + CRUD), job_executor.py (integrated checkpointing + resume), execution_states.py (REST API: GET state, GET nodes, GET context, POST resume). Frontend: useExecutionState.ts (composable), StateViewer.vue (UI panel with node outputs, context, info tabs, resume dialog). Cleanup integrated into job_persistence scheduler.

features.notes: Full stateful execution system: PostgreSQL execution_states table with JSONB node_states and context. Per-node checkpointing after each successful execution. Resume from checkpoint via POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/resume (copies completed state to new job). State Viewer UI with tabs for node outputs, shared context, and metadata. Configurable retention (default 72h) with auto-cleanup.

features.description: DB-First Persistence — Jobs, uploads, và execution data lưu trữ hoàn toàn trong PostgreSQL + MinIO
acceptance_criteria: Jobs là DB-first: tạo job ghi thẳng vào PostgreSQL, server restart không mất data
Load jobs từ DB khi server khởi động (hydrate in-memory queue từ DB)
Mỗi job lưu MinIO path của file đã upload (cột minio_path trong bảng jobs)
Upload file → ghi record vào bảng uploads (filename, minio_path, size, mime_type, uploaded_at)
Kết quả xử lý (results) lưu MinIO path trong DB để có thể download lại
Frontend load job history từ DB API (không phụ thuộc RAM)
File có thể re-download từ MinIO qua API endpoint
Bảng uploads liên kết với bảng jobs (foreign key)
test_steps: Submit job → verify record tồn tại trong PostgreSQL ngay lập tức
Restart backend server → GET /api/v1/jobs → verify jobs vẫn còn
Upload file qua job → verify bảng uploads có record với minio_path
GET /api/v1/uploads/{id} → verify có thể download file từ MinIO
Job completed → verify results chứa minio_path của output
Frontend mở Jobs panel → verify hiển thị jobs từ DB (không phải RAM)
Delete job → verify file vẫn còn trong MinIO (soft reference)
Verify bảng uploads: filename, minio_path, size_bytes, mime_type, job_id, uploaded_at

evidence.test_run: 49 tests pass (29 job_queue + 20 execution_state). Lint clean. Build pass.
evidence.e2e: Backend: workflow_repository.py (uploads table + jobs.minio_path + jobs.result_minio_path columns, CRUD methods), journey_jobs.py (DB-first submit: writes PostgreSQL immediately + uploads MinIO + creates upload record, list_jobs queries DB first with RAM fallback), uploads.py (REST API: list/get/download uploads, get uploads per job). Frontend: JobPanel.vue queries DB-backed API.

features.notes: DB-first architecture: submit_job writes to PostgreSQL immediately (not just sync later). List jobs queries DB as primary source. New uploads table tracks all files with MinIO paths. Download endpoint streams files from MinIO. Jobs table extended with minio_path and result_minio_path columns. Schema migration is additive (ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pattern).
